title: Cleopatra lived closer to the moon landing than to the building of the pyramids
voiceover: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid. Let that sink in. The pyramids were built around twenty-five hundred BC. Cleopatra was born in sixty-nine BC. The moon landing happened in nineteen sixty-nine. That's about two thousand years from her to us... and over twenty-four hundred years from her to the pyramids. To Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient ruins. Older than her than she is to us. History isn't a straight line. It's a long, weird, stretched-out timeline. Follow for one mind-blowing fact a day.
